Software Engineering Intern (AI) - Northstar Systems (Summer 2027)

Build and ship production-quality software with a focus on LLM-powered features.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain features in Python.
- Use Git and Linux for development workflows.
- Integrate LLMs into production services.
- Write automated tests and validate requirements.
- Debug and resolve issues across platforms.

Requirements:
- Currently enrolled in a CS or related program.

- Engineering experience: 0-2 years preferred.
- Experience with C++ is a plus.
- Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a plus.
